mono-0602.d: Two overlapping primary forms, reduced to pure geometry. The kind of print that ages well.

mono-0612.d: Open concentric heptagons, twisting slowly inward. Crisp edges, soft fabric.

mono-0614.d: Dot-matrix diamond on a chunky LED grid. Printer's-proof texture, on purpose.

mono-0632.d: Dense concentric triangles, twisting slowly inward. Works with anything with a straight face.

mono-0634.d: Dot-matrix circle on a chunky LED grid. Tonal depth from one ink.

mono-0637.d: Truchet tiling of half-square triangles, bold and chunky. Works with anything with a straight face.

mono-0652.d: Dense concentric hexagons, twisting slowly inward. Balanced enough to calm a busy outfit.

mono-0659.d: Stippled grain cloud, hand-set dots gathering into separate masses, thick as static. Grey made entirely of dots, the way presses do it.
